scope: gate-capture-config (4 changed gate utility/test files only; component clearance only, not Phase 5 completion)

blockingFindings.title: False-positive maxBuffer overflow classification on ordinary nonzero exits
blockingFindings.expected: Classify buffer overflow strictly from ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER or ENOBUFS error codes; preserve raw output on ordinary nonzero exits.
blockingFindings.actual: isMaxBufferError falls back to err.message.includes('maxBuffer') || err.message.includes('ENOBUFS'), misclassifying ordinary nonzero exits whenever execFile stderr/path or execSync inline script text contains 'maxBuffer' or 'ENOBUFS'.
blockingFindings.fix: Remove the err.message substring fallback in src/utils/gate-runner.ts:25-27 and classify strictly by err.code === 'ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER' || err.code === 'ENOBUFS'; add the 5 real child-process regression cases from false-positive-overflow-regression.patch.

nonblockingImprovements.summary: Add afterEach cleanup of tmpDir created by fs.mkdtempSync.
Guard optional maxBuffer override against non-finite or non-positive numbers (Infinity, NaN, <= 0).
Remove unused name?: unknown from error type cast in isMaxBufferError.
Add unit assertion for runTaskGate forwarding explicit maxBuffer and behavioral runGate overflow test with timeoutMs and stderr.
